title: Bayoglu 2017b: muscle mass of iliocostalis at thoracic_cervical (M, cadaver)

imaging.modality: dissection + laser diffraction + optical tracking of attachments

source.authors: Bayoglu R, Geeraedts L, Groenen KHJ, Verdonschot N, Koopman B, Homminga J
source.sample: 1 embalmed cadaver; one embalmed male cadaver, 79 y, 154 cm, 51 kg (Alzheimer; L5 fused to sacrum); one body side; same cadaver for lumbar (2017a) and thoracic/cervical (2017b) datasets

how_to_simulate: Match model elements to the listed elements by origin/insertion bones.
Compare the model muscle mass per element (and the muscle total/mean where given).
protocol.notes: Per-element values from Table 1 (element #, origin/insertion bone kept; 3-D attachment coordinates NOT stored because minus signs are lost in the PDF text layer - take them from the paper/supplement). Single specimen: no SD across subjects.

extraction.check_notes: Rows parsed from the layout text with a strict regex (19 fields per row), spot-checked against the rendered Table 1 (p.114).
